name: Heartland Solar Solutions
old_description: It’s not just a trend. Solar roofing is here to stay! Why? Solar roofing combines functionality and sustainability, transforming your roof into an energy-producing asset. With state-of-the-art solar technology seamlessly integrated into your home’s design, you’ll enjoy lower energy bills and a reduced carbon footprint. It’s a smart, eco-friendly investment that adds value to your property while contributing to a greener future.
about:
Heartland Solar Solutions operates from Clive, Iowa, serving customers across Iowa and Minnesota under the legal entity Heartland Roofing, Siding and Windows, LLC. The company does not disclose a founding year or ownership structure in its public materials, though it promotes "10+ Years of Solar Expertise" and describes itself as locally recognized and awarded.

The business provides installation and repair services for residential and commercial roofing, siding, windows, gutters, solar arrays, and insulation. Project types include full replacements, targeted repairs, and new installations. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Its customer base consists of homeowners and commercial property owners in the two-state region. Reviews cite projects such as complete roof and siding replacements, window leak repairs, woodpecker-damaged siding replacement, and solar system installations. The company handles both insurance-related repairs and elective upgrades.

Heartland emphasizes transparent communication, on-site cleanliness, and willingness to adjust scope and pricing when conditions change. It highlights a 4.7-star rating, 94% recommendation rate, and an A+ rating as third-party validation of its service quality.
built_on: Transparent scope and pricing adjustments during projects
Crews noted for politeness and thorough cleanup
